title: SureMap: Simultaneous mean estimation for single-task and multi-task disaggregated evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Disaggregated evaluation of tabular classification models (e.g., healthcare and census data) across racial categories using simultaneous Gaussian mean estimation to accurately estimate subpopulation error rates despite data scarcity.

Estimating performance metrics like classification 0-1 error and automated speech recognition Word Error Rate (WER) across sex categories and their intersections using the SureMap mean estimation method.
Evaluating error rates of classification and automated speech recognition models across different age brackets using simultaneous mean estimation with an additive intersectional effects prior.
